.place-profile .venue-avatar { display:block; width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:contain; }
.place-profile .venue-sign {

</style><style>
.dish-favorite {
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 0 14px;
  background: white;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 22px;
  color: var(--green);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.dish-favorite[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #e7f0e9; color: var(--green); border-color: #9ab6a2; }
.dish-favorite[aria-pressed="true"] .icon { fill: currentColor; }
.dish .dish-favorite.compact, .dish-favorite.compact {
  display: inline-flex;
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  padding: 0;
  border-radius: 50%;
}
.dish { position: relative; }
.dish .dish-favorite.compact {
  position: absolute;
  top: 6px;
  right: 6px;
  background: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px #131b1026;
}
.dish .dish-favorite.compact[aria-pressed="true"] {background: #e7f0e9;}
.dish-detail-actions { display: grid; gap: 12px; justify-items: start; margin-top: 16px;}
.dish-rating { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); width: 100%; padding-top: 8px;}
.dish-rating summary, .dish-back, .dish-name, .clear-rating { font: 500 13px/1.4 Gotham,sans-serif; color: var(--green); min-height: 44px; }
.dish-rating summary { padding-block: 12px; }
.dish-rating fieldset { margin: 6px 0; padding: 0; border: 0; }
.dish-rating legend, .dish-rating [role="status"] { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }
.dish-ratings { display: flex; gap: 4px; margin-top: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.dish-ratings label { position: relative; }
.dish-ratings input { position: absolute; inset: 0; margin: 0; height: 100%; width: 100%; opacity: 0; cursor: pointer; }
.dish-ratings span { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 500; }
.dish-ratings :checked + span { color: white; background: var(--green); border-color: var(--green); }
.dish-ratings :focus-visible + span { outline: 3px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 1px; }
.clear-rating { padding: 0; margin-right: 10px; }
.dish-back { padding: 2px 0; }
.dish .dish-name { height: auto; width: auto; font: inherit; }
.dish-detail-photo { max-height: min(240px,30vh); border-radius: 12px; }
@media (max-width:730px) {
  .dish { grid-template-columns: 76px minmax(0,1fr) 44px; gap: 0 10px; }
  .dish .dish-favorite.compact {
    position: static;
    grid-column: 3;
    grid-row: 1 / 4;
    align-self: center;
    box-shadow: none;
  }
  .dish.no-photo { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 0 minmax(0,1fr) 44px; }
}

#au-menu .dishes { align-items: stretch; }
#au-menu .dish, #au-menu .dish.no-photo {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  grid-template-rows: auto minmax(2.34em, auto) auto 1fr;
  align-items: start;
  gap: 5px;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 0 0 12px;
  border: 1px solid #d9d2c1;
  border-radius: 14px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #fffdf7;
}
#au-menu .dish-picture, #au-menu .dish.no-photo::before {
  grid-area: 1 / 1;
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  aspect-ratio: 1.65;
  border-radius: 0;
}
#au-menu .dish.no-photo::before { content: ''; background: var(--cream); }
#au-menu .dish h3, #au-menu .dish > strong, #au-menu .dish > p {
  grid-column: 1;
  padding-inline: 11px;
  margin: 0;
}
#au-menu .dish h3 { grid-row: 2; font-size: 19px; line-height: 1.17; min-height: 2.34em; }
#au-menu .dish-name { text-align: left; padding: 0; min-height: 44px; line-height: inherit; color: inherit; }
#au-menu .dish > strong { grid-row: 3; color: #24533c; padding-block: 0; }
#au-menu .dish > p { grid-row: 4; }
#au-menu .dish .dish-favorite.compact { position: absolute; top: 6px; right: 6px; }


</style><style>
/* Place identity, social proof and food share the tones of the SPAWT atlas. */
body:has(.identity) { background: #f4f0e6; }
.identity {
  background: #f9f4e7;
  border: 1px solid #ccc4af;
  border-radius: 22px;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 10px #25211209;
}
.identity .place-cover { display:block; position:relative; min-width:0; min-height:270px; background:#e6dfce; }
.place-cover .front { position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; cursor:zoom-in; }
.place-cover .front img { object-position:50% 25%; }
.place-cover .front:focus-visible { outline-offset:-4px; }
.place-identity-line { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:15px; margin-bottom:6px; }
.identity .summary { padding: clamp(20px,3vw,36px); align-self: center; }
.identity .kind { color: #435e44; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .065em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.identity h1 { color: #18392b; font-size: clamp(45px,6vw,76px); line-height: .99; margin: 4px 0; }
.identity .address { font-size: 14px; color: #264c38; }
.identity .intro { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.47; margin: 8px 0 10px; }
.identity .special { font-size: 13px; }
.identity .cost { border-color: #d8ceb7; gap: 4px 9px; margin: 14px 0 10px; }
.identity .cost strong { color: #213e2d; font-size: 23px; }
.identity .cost small { color: #575547; font-size: 12px; }
.identity .tags > span { font-size: 12px; padding: 4px 9px; border-radius: 8px; }
.identity .tags .plus { background: #dfe9d8; color: #24492e; }
.identity .tags .minus { background: #f0dcca; color: #683e28; }
.identity .tags .minor { background: transparent; padding: 4px 2px; color: #525342; }
.identity .tag-caption { margin-top: 5px; color: #626153; font-size: 11px; }

.layout { gap: 20px; margin-top: 20px; }
.social {
  background: #193e31;
  color: #fffbeb;
  border: 1px solid #123428;
  padding: 21px 23px;
}
.social .count { color: #d0d9c9; font-size: 12px; white-space: nowrap; }
.social summary { border-top: 1px solid #627668; margin-top: 12px; padding-top: 13px; grid-template-columns: 80px minmax(90px,1fr) auto; }
.social .number strong { font-size: 45px; color: #fff9e9; }
.social .number strong span { color: #dfdfca; }
.social .stars { color: #efcb77; }
.social .stars i { color: #789080; }
.social .criteria { gap: 5px; }
.social .criteria > div { grid-template-columns: 57px minmax(12px,1fr) 25px; gap: 8px; font-size: 13px; }
.social .criteria b { color: #fff9e9; font-size: 12px; }
.social .rail { height: 6px; background: #436452; }
.social .rail i { background: #edcb7a; }
.social .read { color: #fff6dd; font-size: 13px; }
.social .mini-author { color: #e1e3d3; font-size: 12px; gap: 7px; }
.social .mini-author img { width: 33px; height: 33px; background: #fff2d5; }
.social summary:focus-visible { outline-color: #f2ce77; }
.social .review-list { border-color: #627668; }
.social .review-by p { color: #e1e3d3; }
.social .review-by b, .social .quote { color: #fff9ec; }
.social .marks { color: #f4d694; }

.menu { background: #fffdf7; border-color: #d9d2c1; padding: 21px 23px; }
.menu .heading h2, #situation h2, .practical summary { color: #203e30; }
.menu .menu-label { font-size: 13px; color: #55594e; }
.menu .dishes { gap: 15px; }
.menu .dish-picture { height: clamp(120px,13vw,155px); background: #ebe5d9; }
.menu .dish-picture img { transition: transform .2s ease; }
@media (hover:hover) and (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference) {
  .photos button:hover img { filter: brightness(1.045); }
  .menu .dish-picture:hover img { transform: scale(1.04); }
}
.menu .dish h3 { font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.13; color: #20362a; }
.menu .dish p { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.4; color: #505449; }
.menu .dish strong { font-size: 14px; color: #234831; }
.menu .all-menu { min-height: 44px; font-size: 13px; }
.layout #situation { background: #e6e5d2; border-color: #cdd1b9; }
#situation .map-image { aspect-ratio: 720 / 325; height: auto; background: #f4f0e7; border: 1px solid #cad0bc; }
#situation .map-image img { object-fit: contain; }
#situation .map-address b { font-size: 15px; }
#situation .map-address p { color: #52584a; font-size: 13px; }
.practical { background: #f8f7ee; border-color: #d6d7c5; }
.practical dt, .practical dd { font-size: 13px; }

@media (max-width:730px) {

  .identity .summary { width: 100%; padding: 16px 18px; }
  .identity .place-cover { min-height:0; height:clamp(178px,48vw,255px); }
  .place-cover .front img { object-position:50% 19%; }
  .place-identity-line { gap:12px; }
  .place-identity-line { --profile-size:58px; }
  .identity h1 { font-size: 45px; }
  .identity .kind { font-size: 11px; }
  .identity .intro { font-size: 14px; margin: 4px 0 7px; }
  .identity .special { font-size: 12px; gap: 3px 7px; }
  .identity .cost { margin: 9px 0 8px; }
  .identity .cost strong { font-size: 21px; }
  .identity .tags > span { font-size: 11px; }
  .layout { padding: 12px; gap: 12px; margin-top: 0; }
  .social,.menu { padding: 16px; }
  .social summary { grid-template-columns: 55px minmax(90px,1fr) auto; gap: 9px; }
  .social .number strong { font-size: 37px; }
  .social .criteria > div { grid-template-columns: 45px minmax(15px,1fr) 20px; gap: 4px; font-size: 12px; }
  .social .mini-author,.social .read { font-size: 11px; }
  .social .mini-author img { width: 28px; height: 28px; }
  .menu .dishes {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: none;
    grid-auto-flow: column;
    grid-auto-columns: min(79%,270px);
    gap: 12px;
    overflow-x: auto;
    scroll-snap-type: x proximity;
    scrollbar-color: #b7bba5 transparent;
    scrollbar-width: thin;
    padding: 3px 2px 10px;
  }
  .menu .dish, .menu .dish.no-photo {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;

      String(b.date || '').localeCompare(String(a.date || '')) || a.id.localeCompare(b.id);
  }
  function render() {
    const own = window.lireMonAvisSpawt?.();
    const all = own ? [...FICHE.reviews, own] : FICHE.reviews.slice();
    let points = 0;
    let votes = 0;
    for (const review of all) {
      const weight = weights[review.rankCode] || 1;
      points += review.score * weight;
      votes += weight;
    }
    const score = votes ? points / votes : 0;
    const authors = new Set(all.map(review => review.authorId || review.author)).size;
    const byline = authors ? 'D’après l’avis de ' + authors + (authors === 1 ? ' spawter' : ' spawters') : 'Donner le premier avis';
    for (const node of document.querySelectorAll('[data-spawters-byline]')) node.textContent = byline;
    const countText = all.length + ' avis';
    for (const node of document.querySelectorAll('[data-bande-score]')) node.textContent = format.format(score);
    for (const node of document.querySelectorAll('[data-review-count]')) node.textContent = countText;
    if (!axes) return;
    const stars = document.querySelector('.bande-stars');
    stars.style.setProperty('--bande-fill', (score / 5 * 100) + '%');
    axes.replaceChildren(...labels.map(label => {
      const values = all.flatMap(review => review.notes.filter(pair => pair[0] === label).map(pair => pair[1]));
      const rating = values.reduce((sum,x) => sum + x,0) / values.length;
      const row = make('div'), rail = make('span',undefined,'rail'), fill = make('i');
      rail.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
      fill.style.width = rating / 5 * 100 + '%';
      rail.append(fill);
      row.append(make('span',label), rail, make('b',format.format(rating)));
      return row;
    }));
    const ordered = all.sort(compareReviews);
    const featured = [...ordered.filter(r => !r.own && r.id !== 'avis-fourni-lecha').slice(0,2),
      ordered.find(r => r.id === 'avis-fourni-lecha'), own].filter(Boolean);
    renderReviewCards(featured, ordered);
  }
  render();
  window.addEventListener('spawt:avis-change', render);
  window.addEventListener('pageshow', event => { if (event.persisted) render(); });
})();
